xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3512: The verdict write door — recordReviewVerdict + dispatch-not-drop + fallback kill-conditional (write-side of the verdict-of-record contract)

plan.title: The verdict write door — recordReviewVerdict + dispatch-not-drop + fallback kill-conditional (write-side of the verdict-of-record contract)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5

narratives.Problem: rejectVerdictEvidenceHeadMismatch (src/lib/review-verdict-guards.ts:69, invoked from src/lib/review-status.ts:196) silently deletes a terminal review verdict whenever the review's evidence head differs from the row's lastVerifiedCommit: one console.warn, the OLD status re-emitted, no event, no activity entry, no route to an honest next step. On 2026-08-02 that destroyed five APPROVED verdicts on PAN-1577 in one evening, because the deacon fallback synthesized APPROVED at a FRESHER head than the stale row anchor and then killed the convoy parent unconditionally (deacon-review-signals.ts:247) regardless of the rejected write. Underneath sit nine terminal-verdict write sites with no shared contract and no way for any caller to learn whether its write landed.
narratives.Proposal: Introduce one verdict write door, src/lib/cloister/review-verdict-writer.ts exporting recordReviewVerdict(issueId, input): Promise<{landed:true;classification}|{landed:false;reason}>. It classifies the evidence head against the row head with a polyrepo-aware ancestor probe: provably-stale evidence is rejected WITH a review.verdict_rejected domain event and an activity entry (never silently), and every other disagreement LANDS the verdict, anchors reviewedAtCommit to the evidence head, resets the test gate to pending in the same update, and emits review.verdict_dispatched. Resetting the test gate is what keeps the merge gate honest: reviewGatesPassedSync cannot return true at a head no gate ran against, and the existing reactive review->test handoff dispatches the test role at the new head. The REVIEW arm of rejectVerdictEvidenceHeadMismatch is then deleted (the TEST arm survives untouched), nine call sites migrate to the door, and the deacon fallback's killSession plus its blocked-feedback delivery become conditional on landed === true.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT edit src/lib/review-status.ts: it is at EXACTLY its allowlisted 1034 lines (PAN-3253) and this issue must leave it at zero delta.
- Do NOT change the TEST arm of rejectVerdictEvidenceHeadMismatch (src/lib/review-verdict-guards.ts:56-63); test-verdict writes keep today's guard.
- Do NOT implement the read side (artifact consults in feedback-target, infra-failure, sweeper stuck-flag; journal-vs-artifact disagreement) — that is PAN-3511.
- Do NOT create the sweeper restore call site in src/lib/cloister/stall-sweeper.ts; PAN-3512 ships only the 'sweeper-restore' writer tag and its fixture, PAN-3511 WI-6 wires the call.
- Do NOT migrate terminal-verdict writers that carry no evidence head and are pure reconciliation: review mode 'none' skip (review-agent.ts:353), review spawn failure (review-agent.ts:773), merged-issue reconcile (deacon-merge.ts:531), PAN-869 COMMENTED backfill (review-status.ts:861), verification-failed writes (review-pipeline.ts:356,374), merge fulfillment reconcile (merge-fulfillment.ts:445). They never reached the guard.
- Do NOT call runVerificationForIssue from inside the door; the reactive test dispatch owns re-verification.
- Do NOT change readyForMerge derivation, reviewGatesPassedSync, or any merge path.
- Do NOT delete a verdict artifact when a write is rejected; the artifact is the verdict of record.
- No browser/UAT verification is required for this issue: it changes no rendered surface.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete the guard's REVIEW arm outright instead of making it conditional on a marker field threaded through setReviewStatusSync.
autoDecisions.rationale: A marker field would grow src/lib/review-status.ts, which is at exactly its allowlisted 1034-line ceiling with zero headroom (PAN-3253). Owning the whole decision inside the new door module keeps that file at zero delta and puts the rule in one place. Safe because every evidence-carrying writer migrates in the same issue.

autoDecisions.summary: On a landed head disagreement the door resets the test gate (testStatus passed|skipped -> pending) in the same update, rather than relying solely on the merge-time gate.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's requirement offers 'confirm and cite, or add the block'. The merge-time gate IS confirmed and cited (triggerMerge Step 3, merge-ops.ts:994-1070), but it protects the merge, not the advertised state: between landing and merging, the issue would sit readyForMerge=true, auto-merge eligible, and merge-train eligible at a head only the reviewer saw. The reset makes the regression structurally impossible and also triggers the existing reactive review->test dispatch, which is the verification re-run the issue asks for.

autoDecisions.summary: The door does not invoke runVerificationForIssue inline; it resets the test gate and lets the reactive review->test handoff dispatch the test role.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verification is the full quality-gate suite (minutes). Calling it from a deacon patrol callback would block the patrol tick. The reactive handoff at review-status.ts:479-502 already dispatches the test role when review passes with testStatus pending, its canSkipTests shortcut is false by construction when heads differ, and deacon.ts:1336 is the existing backstop if the reactive path misses.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope expanded from the issue's five named writers to the nine call sites found by a tree census, and the census is recorded in the PRD.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says 'every verdict writer migrates' and names five. The tree at c7b6d2e5f1e has nine terminal-review-verdict sites, and two the issue did not name (deacon-review-unsignaled.ts:316, deacon.ts:1557) carry evidence heads — so deleting the guard's review arm without migrating them would silently drop them out of protection. Six other writers carry no evidence head, never reached the guard, and stay put.

autoDecisions.summary: A composite-vs-bare head-anchor shape disagreement classifies as 'indeterminate' and LANDS, never as 'stale'.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-3254 (workspace-anchor-drift.ts:88-96) established that a shape disagreement is a producer disagreement rather than evidence about code; treating it as drift re-drove MIN-901 through 426 identical review cycles in 19.5 hours. Once the test gate is reset, landing is the conservative option: an unlanded verdict is invisible, a landed one is re-gated.

autoDecisions.summary: The 'sweeper-restore' writer tag ships with a unit fixture but no call site.
autoDecisions.rationale: The sweeper restore is created by PAN-3511 WI-6, a separate in-flight issue editing the same files. Shipping the tag now means PAN-3511 wires a call rather than negotiating a contract, and avoids a cross-branch conflict in stall-sweeper.ts.

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/review-verdict-writer.ts exporting the VerdictWriter union ('coordinator' | 'fallback' | 'quick-signal' | 'orphan-restore' | 'sweeper-restore' | 'unsignaled-recovery' | 'infra-bypass'), the VerdictInput interface, the VerdictOutcome union, and async recordReviewVerdict(issueId, input) — the exact signatures are in PRD section 6.1. Flow: read the row with getReviewStatusSync; when input.evidenceHead is absent, or status.lastVerifiedCommit is absent, or the two anchors are equal, build the update and call setReviewStatusSync exactly as today and return { landed: true, classification: 'no-evidence' | 'anchor-match' } (this preserves NFR-4 byte for byte). When the anchors differ, call the module-private classifyEvidenceAgainstAnchor: 'stale' emits a review.verdict_rejected event via getCloisterEventStore()?.append plus an emitActivityEntrySync entry naming the writer, both heads, and the reason, then returns { landed: false, reason: 'stale-evidence-head' } WITHOUT touching the row; any other classification lands the verdict with reviewedAtCommit set to the evidence head, emits review.verdict_dispatched plus an activity entry, and returns { landed: true, classification: 'dispatched' }. The classifier is polyrepo-aware per PRD section 6.2: parseCompositeSnapshot (src/lib/git-utils.ts:359) on both anchors, repo roots from resolveWorkspaceRepoRootsSync (src/lib/project-repos.ts) with the workspace path resolved the way readLatestSynthesisVerdict does (src/lib/cloister/synthesis-verdict.ts:60-66), and a per-repo execFileAsync('git', ['merge-base', '--is-ancestor', evidenceSha, rowSha], { cwd: root.dir, timeout: 10_000 }) probe. 'stale' requires every repo to answer ancestor-or-equal with at least one sha differing; a shape disagreement, a differing repo key set, an unresolvable root, or any non-clean exec failure yields 'indeterminate'. NEVER use execSync. The test-gate reset belongs to the next item — implement recordReviewVerdict here without it. Tests use the vi.hoisted mock pattern from src/lib/cloister/__tests__/verdict-preservation.test.ts:1-20 to stub getReviewStatusSync, setReviewStatusSync, the event store, and execFileAsync.

items.title: Given a VerdictInput with no evidenceHead, recordReviewVerdict calls setReviewStatusSync once with the verdict fields and returns { landed: true, classification: 'no-evidence' }

Given an evidenceHead that a per-repo `git merge-base --is-ancestor` probe proves is a strict ancestor of the row's lastVerifiedCommit, recordReviewVerdict returns { landed: false, reason: 'stale-evidence-head' }, makes zero setReviewStatusSync calls, and appends one review.verdict_rejected event

Given an evidenceHead the probe shows is NOT an ancestor of the row head, recordReviewVerdict lands the verdict with reviewedAtCommit set to that evidenceHead, appends one review.verdict_dispatched event, and returns { landed: true, classification: 'dispatched' }
Given a bare-SHA evidenceHead against a composite 'repoKey@sha' row anchor, the classifier produces 'indeterminate' and the verdict still lands — it is never rejected as stale

Given a composite anchor pair where one repo is behind and another is ahead, the classifier produces 'fresh' and the verdict lands; `git grep -c execSync src/lib/cloister/review-verdict-writer.ts` returns 0
